answer: Forging N identities costs N bonds plus sustained epoch participation, making mass fakery far pricier than one honest node. Sybil resistance via stake-weighted identity: each agent must lock a bond to register, and voting power scales with bonded stake decayed by tenure. Like a pearl formed only under pressure, trust accrues slowly; a tundra of fresh keys stays frozen out until tenure thaws, while a single oasis of verified stake anchors consensus and dilutes attackers.
